concepts.name: The Matrix
concepts.description: A vast, simulated reality constructed by machines to subdue the human population and use their bodies as an energy source. It functions as a prison for the mind, with rules that can be bent or broken by those who understand its nature.

concepts.name: The Machines
concepts.description: The sentient computer civilization that created the Matrix and rules the real world. They harvest human bio-electric energy and view humanity as a virus that must be contained or cured.

concepts.name: The Agents
concepts.description: Programs within the Matrix that act as law enforcement and hunters of resistance fighters. They are capable of transforming, replicating, and perceiving through electronic devices to track down those who have been 'unplugged'.

concepts.name: Zion
concepts.description: The last free human city, located deep underground in the real world. It is the base of operations for the resistance against the Machines and the origin point for the hovercrafts that enter the Matrix.

concepts.name: The Resistance
concepts.description: The collective of humans who have escaped the Matrix and fight for human freedom. They operate from Zion and use hovercrafts to navigate the real world and send operatives into the simulation.

concepts.name: The Construct
concepts.description: A blank, white virtual space used by the crew to load characters, weapons, and scenarios into the Matrix. It is a place of pure potential where the rules of the simulation can be defined or ignored.

aliases: INT. HEART O' THE CITY HOTEL

INT. HEART O' THE CITY HOTEL - NIGHT

concepts.description: A fire-damaged hotel in the Matrix where Trinity is initially found. It is the site of the first police raid in the film and the location where Trinity demonstrates her abilities to the Agents.

concepts.name: Oracle's Apartment
concepts.description: The home of the Oracle in the Matrix. It is a normal, lived-in apartment that contrasts with the sterile environments of the Agents and the Construct. It is where Neo receives his prophecy.

concepts.name: Sentinels
concepts.description: Autonomous combat drones deployed by the Machines in the real world. They are equipped with electromagnetic pulse weapons and are capable of destroying hovercrafts if they detect their presence.

concepts.name: Drive Chairs
concepts.description: Mechanical chairs used to suspend the bodies of operatives while their minds are in the Matrix. They are connected to the main deck computer and can be used to extract or kill the occupant.

concepts.name: Rules of the Matrix
concepts.description: The fundamental laws governing the simulated reality, such as gravity and physics. These rules can be perceived and manipulated by those who understand that the Matrix is a program, allowing for feats of superhuman ability.

concepts.name: Police
concepts.description: The law enforcement force in the Matrix. They are ordinary humans who are unaware of the simulation and are used by the Agents to track and capture resistance fighters.

concepts.name: Electromagnetic Pulse
concepts.description: A weapon or defense mechanism used by the Machines and the Resistance. It can disable electronic devices and is used by the Nebuchadnezzar to hide from Sentinels.

concepts.name: Fetus Fields
concepts.description: An area within the Power Plant where human fetuses are grown and harvested. The machines use these bodies to replenish the population of the Matrix.
